about: Shirak Airport is 5 km from Gyumri and 120 km from Yerevan. The new arrivals hall opened in 2021.

transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: By car from Gyumri: turn towards Shirak Airport at the 3.5 km mark on Yerevanyan highway, then continue for another 2 km. SIXT provides a Meet & Greet service: there is no rental office at the airport, and a staff member meets you in the arrivals hall with a SIXT sign. SIXT parking is in front of the main airport building.
